properties.morphology: nanostructured multilayer particles; FESEM (REMMA 102-02, Fig.1) clearly shows CuO catalytic centers on the surface
properties.synthesis_method: three-stage synthesis: (1) deposition of iron and cobalt hydroxides from salt solutions onto preformed SiO2 particles; (2) porous SiO2 layer formed by sol-gel method; (3) deposition of copper hydroxide, followed by annealing of the composite
